archetypes.name: dyn-repo-resolution-contract
archetypes.rationale: Caller contracts for invalid candidates, origin fallback, and diagnostic preservation are easy to drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the migrated resolve_repo_detailed path and every caller that changed from gh-only or raw gh repo view discovery. Confirm invalid non-empty ambient candidates still map to clarify invalid-repo, report_tokens_scan still emits redacted nonzero and OSError diagnostics without a second discovery command, and ordinary callers only see the validating str|None adapter. Check that cwd still propagates to primary and origin commands. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
